A.method: diff = sampling minus coordination. Accuracy in percentage points; tokens = mean total tokens per query. Item-level: paired bootstrap over items of seed-averaged values (stats.paired_test resampling). Hierarchical: stats.hier_paired_test (items, then seeds within item). 10,000 replicates, seed 0. Token CI: item-level paired bootstrap only. Holm: within each task block, over all sampling x coordination pairs, separately per bootstrap. Classification uses unadjusted 95% CIs; 'cheaper' = lower mean total tokens (point estimate), and every such token CI is reported.

B.method: Per-config means: per-record values averaged over seeds within item, then over items. latency_s is the logged sum of per-call wall-clock latencies (calls issued one at a time; client.cost_of). Price-weighted cost = in_tokens + r * out_tokens (r = output:input price ratio; r=1 equals total tokens). Idealized critical path = depth x (latency_s / n_calls) per record, depth: SA/SC 1, DEBATE R+1, HIER 3, GE/GES/HIERC n_calls; not a measurement. serial_latency_s_seed1_only uses seed-1 records' latency (accuracy still seed-averaged), because some seed-2 runs were made under machine load. Pareto frontier on point estimates (analyze.pareto_frontier: not dominated by a config with >= accuracy and <= cost, one strict).

definitions.round0_majority: harness/topologies.py:81-83 (trace hook) and harness/traces.py:44: init_answer = topologies._majority(round-0 answers of the N=3 agents); init_correct = task score of that answer. Round 0 = three independent calls on the unmodified task prompt, T=0.7, seeds seed*1000+a (a=0,1,2), i.e. the same prompt, temperature and seed derivation as SC samples 0..2 (topologies.py:54 vs 77).
definitions.final: majority of the round-1 (post-critique) answers, same _majority (topologies.py:103); final_correct = its score.
definitions.ties: _majority (topologies.py:17-28): None answers are dropped; votes are compared as str(answer) with no normalization; Counter.most_common(1) returns, among equally frequent answers, the one first seen in agent order (agent 0 first). All-None -> None (scored wrong). So a 1-1-1 split returns agent 0's answer (or the first non-None).
definitions.gsm8k_source_note: GSM8K round-0 data come from results/mechanistic.jsonl, written by harness/mechanistic.py, a standalone re-implementation of the same prompts, seeds (seed 1) and _majority (mechanistic.py:9,29); it logs init_correct/final_correct only, not the per-agent answers or tokens.

gsm8k_n80.round0_tokens_note: not logged in mechanistic.jsonl; INFERRED as 3/8 of matrix SC_k8 mean total tokens (identical prompt and sampling).

per_sample.note: SC_k8 per-sample answers are NOT logged: the matrix records have no 'raw' field (runner.run_config log_raw defaults to False, runner.py:50,74-75; scripts/run_matrix.py does not set it). Only the vote (pred) is stored. Two partial substitutes exist and are reported below: (i) the SC k=2 agreement probes (run with log_raw=True, scripts/run_probe.py), a separate re-run of SC_k2 seed 1, not the matrix records; (ii) debate round 0, a 3-sample majority vote with per-agent answers logged (section C).

E.parse_failure_definition: gsm8k_extract (harness/tasks.py:73-78) returns the number after 'answer is', else the LAST number anywhere in the text, else None. pred is JSON null exactly when the output contains no number at all; gsm8k_score (tasks.py:81-83) scores None as wrong. 'Parse failure' below = pred is None. Outputs that lack 'The answer is N.' but contain any number are parsed (fallback); raw texts are not logged, so the fallback cases cannot be separated from compliant outputs.

F.code:
17: def _majority(answers):
18:     """Most common non-None answer; None if all None."""
19:     vals = [a for a in answers if a is not None]
20:     if not vals:
21:         return None
22:     # Counter on stringified to handle floats/ints uniformly, map back.
23:     c = Counter(str(v) for v in vals)
24:     top = c.most_common(1)[0][0]
25:     for v in vals:
26:         if str(v) == top:
27:             return v
28:     return vals[0]
F.rule: None answers are discarded; remaining answers are counted by str(); Counter.most_common(1) (CPython: heapq.nlargest with n=1 -> max(), which keeps the first maximal item in insertion order) returns the answer whose first occurrence is earliest among the tied answers. SC k=2 with two different answers -> sample 0 (seed*1000+0); with sample 0 unparseable -> sample 1. SC k=8 4-4 or 3-3-2 splits -> the tied answer seen first in sample order. DEBATE 1-1-1 -> agent 0's answer. No normalization before voting (MATH: equivalent answers in different strings are different votes).

G.relation: the 200-item run contains the 80 matrix items but is a separate run (RTX 4060 per scripts/emit_throughput.py docstring): 16 of 400 overlapping (item, config, seed) records have identical total_tokens.
